## The five reproductions {#hands-on-3b-a-second-reproduction .smaller}

::: {.small}
The five analyses side by side. Three pairs of them differ in **one** decision:

- **the comparison** – 8PTRZ (all other names) against UYV3F (white names only)
- **the emails counted** – UYV3F (the coded replies) against 25N5D (every delivered email)
- **the test** – UYV3F (the *z* of one coefficient) against P9W8Y (a test of three groups)
:::

::: notes
Between you, the class has now reproduced all five analyses, and three pairs of them differ in a single decision. 8PTRZ and UYV3F differ in the comparison, all the other names against the white names only. UYV3F and 25N5D differ in the emails counted, the replies against every delivered email. UYV3F and P9W8Y differ in the test, one coefficient against the three groups at once. [advance] The statistics recorded in the robustness study, a chi-square here and a z there, cannot be compared directly, so the table gives each analysis as a gap in percentage points, from the workshop's refit of it. [advance] The question for all of us is which of the five answers the claim as it was selected, the Hispanic against the white names, and which question each of the others answers instead. :::
